title: Hypergraph Structural Entropy-Enhanced Hierarchy-Aware Semi-Supervised Graph Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.27043v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semi-supervised graph classification aims to learn graph-level representations by leveraging a large number of unlabeled graphs alongside a small set of labeled ones, effectively mitigating the issue of label scarcity. Despite significant progress by various semi-supervised learning strategies, complex relationships among graph vertices beyond pairwise edges, especially hierarchical structures, remain underexplored by existing methods. In this work, we propose a Hypergraph Structural Entropy-Enhanced hierarchy-aware framework, namely HypSEE, for semi-supervised graph classification. Specifically, we first construct walk-induced and embedding-derived hypergraphs to capture hierarchy-aware local and long-range higher-order relationships within graphs. translated_title: 超图结构熵增强的层次感知半监督图分类
translated_abstract: 半监督图分类旨在利用大量无标签图与少量有标签图来学习图级表示，从而有效缓解标签稀缺问题。尽管各种半监督学习策略已取得显著进展，但图中顶点之间超越成对边的复杂关系，尤其是层次结构，仍未被现有方法充分探索。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种超图结构熵增强的层次感知框架——HypSEE，用于半监督图分类。具体而言，我们首先构建游走诱导超图和嵌入衍生超图，以捕获图内层次感知的局部和长程高阶关系。然后，我们设计了一种由超图结构熵（HSE）引导的层次超图池化方法，以促进超图中的层次表示学习。最后，我们采用（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出HypSEE框架，通过构建游走诱导与嵌入衍生超图捕获层次感知的局部和长程高阶关系，并利用超图结构熵引导的层次超图池化方法实现半监督图分类中的层次表示学习。
